video_title: Draymond Green Gives Free Agency Update & Reacts To LeBron Heat Drama & Steph Curry HOF Exhibit

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green provides an update on his current free agency status
quotes.excerpt: I am still unsigned. I have no contract offer. The Warriors haven't offered me a contract yet.
quotes.quote: I am still unsigned. I have no contract offer. The Warriors haven't offered me a contract yet, so I am still unsigned. Hoping for an offer at some point in the near future. Now, I am just joking. However, I am unsigned still and waiting. As I told you all when this first kicked off, we were going to be patient, we were going to figure it all out, and we will figure it out. No one's patience have worn thin. My patience haven't worn thin, Rich Paul's patience haven't worn thin, neither have the Warriors' patience worn thin, or anyone else for that matter. So, here we are.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green discusses the Miami Heat's accidental LeBron James press conference post
quotes.excerpt: I definitely believe in my heart of hearts that it was intentional.
quotes.quote: The Miami Heat posted a link to a scheduled live stream titled LeBron James introductory press conference, followed by the date July 27th to a YouTube channel. The Miami Heat then proceeded to say that was a mistake, and the Miami Heat then pulled out all the stops and even said, hey, we are going to post this job because essentially hinting that we fired that person who made the mistake. I don't believe either one of those for not one second. Is a LeBron James Miami Heat introductory press conference scheduled? I don't know, I have no idea. I don't think it was a mistake, though. Whether that's the plan or whether Miami was trying to rattle the cages a little bit, I don't know. I just personally do not think that it was a mistake. I definitely believe in my heart of hearts that it was intentional.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green praises Jalen Hood-Schifino's performance and mentality in Summer League
quotes.excerpt: I think Jalen Hood-Schifino and Caleb Wilson kind of approached Summer League with the same mentality.
quotes.quote: Summer League has come to a conclusion and Jalen Hood-Schifino went and racked up everything. Jalen Hood-Schifino won MVP, Jalen Hood-Schifino won Finals MVP, Jalen Hood-Schifino won the championship, and I think that was incredible. To see him go out there and I think approach the Summer League with the mindset that he approached it. I think Jalen Hood-Schifino and Caleb Wilson kind of approached Summer League with the same mentality, like, I am not sitting out early, I am here to prove myself, I am here to show y'all that I am just a little bit different. And Jalen Hood-Schifino went and showed that. He had a great display, showed his all-around game, shooting ability, getting to the rack and finishing, rebounding, playmaking. I feel like he showed a bit of everything, and I thought that was beautiful.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green explains the importance of young players building relationships with coaching staff
quotes.excerpt: You need those people on your side. As equally important as it is for the coach to love you.
quotes.quote: I spoke about Khalid Robinson on the last podcast where I was just speaking about him getting up there and getting on the mic and his post-game press conference after they won the championship. The reason it's important is because I am speaking to young guys when I say this. You need to understand the layout of these organizations. I think so oftentimes people come in and they think, oh man, like if the head coach like me, I am good. And that's so far from the truth because what you have to understand in this league is there is someone or a few someones, if you will, that the coach may, if you take a weighted approach, right, and you take different opinions, there is a few people on the staff that the weight of their opinion could be a little higher. And what these young guys should understand is you need those people on your side. As equally important as it is for the coach to love you, it is as important for the guys who got his ear to love you.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green reacts to Steph Curry's upcoming Hall of Fame exhibit
quotes.excerpt: It's a reason it's never happened. It's a reason this is the first, because Steph Curry is just something different.
quotes.quote: Per Anthony Slater, the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame will launch a new exhibit this weekend dedicated to the Golden State Warriors star Steph Curry. Representing the first time in nearly the 75-year history that an active player will be honored within the walls with a dedicated exhibit. The exhibit is titled Steph Curry: Beyond the Arc. My thoughts on this are that this is insane. It's a reason it's never happened. It's a reason this is the first, because Steph Curry is just something different. The way he's changed the game of basketball, the way he's made kids dream because of the size that he is, because he did it with finesse if you will in shooting the basketball and not necessarily dunking the basketball or off athleticism, which I think the most special players we've ever seen in NBA history, a lot of them, it's built somewhat off athleticism and Steph's the complete opposite. And so, I think this is special. Congrats to 30. This is, I mean, he's not even in the Hall of Fame yet. Obviously, we know he's going, but to not be in the Hall of Fame and yet have something dedicated to you at the Hall of Fame, man, I tip my cap to that brother.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green reacts to Bleacher Report's top 50 trash talkers list
quotes.excerpt: This is trash talking, and this is talking that shit, and that's what I do. I talk that shit.
quotes.quote: Bleacher Report ranked their top 50 trash talkers ever. The top 10 was Larry Bird, Kevin Garnett, Magic Johnson, Gary Payton, Kobe Bryant, Reggie Miller, Charles Barkley, Rasheed Wallace, myself, and Isaiah Thomas. Listen, now this one, this one I will argue. I think I am, I think I am above all these guys. I do. But this is, however, this is not like a, this is very speculative. It's not, oh man, it's defense, it's offense, it's three-point. This is trash talking, and this is talking that shit, and that's what I do. I talk that shit. So, number nine, I think is a bit wild. I go toe-to-toe with any of these guys when it comes to doing that. Needless to say, these are all Hall of Fame basketball players, and another list, top 10 that I am happy to be on.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green discusses the Wilt Chamberlain warm-up jacket found at a Goodwill
quotes.excerpt: Go to your local Goodwill, man, and see what the hell you can find.
quotes.quote: Go to your local Goodwill, man, and at a Portland Goodwill, Wilt Chamberlain warm-up jacket was originally found in January by a 19-year-old named Quinn Brown and sold for $89,600 at Sotheby's. He bought the jacket for $3.7. So, this is just a public service announcement, go to your local Goodwill or wherever you go and see what the hell you can find, because maybe you too can make $89,000. When I get done with this, I am on my way to Goodwill right now because I need to find something like that.
